source_filter_audit.method: Read archive CSV and notebook cells as inert data. No source notebook/script/model was executed.
source_filter_audit.curve_rule: Iteratively remove a point if its omission changes the interpolating VSSE-versus-HFX spline by more than 5 kcal/mol over the sampled interval.
source_filter_audit.candidate_eligibility: Source convergence and spin-contamination screening, HFX-curve cleaning, density availability, complete finite reference/all45 values, and cross-task formula exclusion.
source_filter_audit.inference_limit: Source preselection is retained. It is not this recommender selecting records by its final prediction error, and it does not establish an unbiased chemical cohort.

state_definition.section: Methods / Data set construction, PDF page 22 (zero-based page 21)
state_definition.limitation: The d4 singlet/quintet comparison is the source archive convention, not a universal lowest-spin octahedral d4 rule. Other spin-state ordering is not certified.

mapping_evidence.all_VSS: Same-named structures.csv/XYZ association, atom count, source network-group-code sequence and zero padding checked.
not_independently_verified: Actual-element atom order within source shared groups

numerical_independent_check.computation: In-memory pure numeric exported inference and trusted CSV-column absolute-error scoring. No fitting or selection was performed.
numerical_independent_check.model_configuration_basis: 117-row formula-group training CV, frozen before this v2 final scoring

current_candidate_reported_intervals.history_note: The earlier report.json used source formula strings for sorted cluster keys. The seeded finite resampling sequence changes when group keys change, giving different endpoints; both reported intervals cross zero.
